Hiya

Runtime

Video 01

Paste the YouTube ID into data-video-id

Reflection

I composed and arranged the music for Hiya and directed the overall audiovisual production for my band, Chirkutt. It was a chance to translate musical ideas into a complete visual and sonic experience, and I shaped the creative direction so that the arrangement and the visual narrative complemented one another. I chose an abstract form of art, using shifting colours as forms of the tune, so that each change in sound could be seen as well as heard. The project strengthened my understanding of how sound can influence storytelling, and of how music and visual expression can work together to create a unified artistic identity. I went on with abstract form of art expressing various colors as forms of tune.

My role

Composer, arranger and director of the audiovisual production.

Credits

  • Composition and arrangement: Dodul Nasser Dibbo
  • Audiovisual direction: Dodul Nasser Dibbo
  • Band: Chirkutt

Video 02

Paste the YouTube ID into data-video-id

Reflection

I composed and arranged the musical material for Tomar Jonno Gaan and directed this audiovisual piece, overseeing its creative direction from both a musical and a visual perspective. My intention was an experience in which sound and imagery support each other rather than existing independently. The lyrics, tune, vocals, mixing, recording and editing were all done by me, and the whole piece was executed within 24 hours with some help from my colleagues. Working under that constraint sharpened my creative decision-making, arrangement and artistic direction, and taught me indoor shooting and lighting structures far more concretely than before.

My role

Composer, lyricist, vocalist, recording and mix engineer, editor and director.

Credits

  • Lyrics, tune and vocals: Dodul Nasser Dibbo
  • Recording, mixing and editing: Dodul Nasser Dibbo
  • Direction: Dodul Nasser Dibbo, with support from colleagues

Reflection

This instrumental reflects my personal exploration of guitar-driven composition and contemporary instrumental music. I composed and arranged the piece and directed its audiovisual presentation. As a guitarist, I wanted to explore how instrumental music can communicate emotion, movement and identity without relying on lyrics. The project let me experiment with musical structure, tone, arrangement and visual presentation, and it deepened my interest in the relationship between sound, instruments and audiovisual experience.

My role

Composer, arranger, guitarist and director of the audiovisual presentation.

Credits

  • Composition and arrangement: Dodul Nasser Dibbo
  • Audiovisual direction: Dodul Nasser Dibbo

Background

About Dibbo

Dodul Nasser Dibbo is a Dhaka-based guitarist and composer, lead guitarist of Chirkutt, the internationally performing Bangladeshi folk-rock band, and founder of the progressive rock band Fantasy Realm, established in 2019.

In 2025 he contributed to Chirkutt's fourth studio album, Bhalobasha Shomogro, and released Fantasy Realm's studio album, 21g.

His session guitar work includes projects with the late Shafin Ahmed (Miles), Sunidhi Nayak, Pritom Hasan, Rafa, Arekta Rock Band, and Shishir Ahmed. He has also contributed to music for films, television dramas, television commercials, jingles, voice-over productions, and collaborative arrangements.

His professional experience includes time at Radio Today 89.6 FM and work associated with Niketon, which shaped a working habit of serving the needs of a piece, a brand, or a collaborator before his own instincts.
